title: lithocarpus uvariifolius
intro: Lithocarpus uvariifolius, commonly known as the Fagaceae family's Lithocarpus uvariifolius, is a species of evergreen tree. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Lithocarpus uvariifolius include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus uvariifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety, and fighting off infections.
